title: Record reproducible test proof
statement: As a developer preparing a change, I can define a test for a specific acceptance criterion and append its evidence and run result so the proof is reproducible without rewriting history.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A test case can verify an exact acceptance criterion revision, and the link is reported stale when that criterion changes until the relation is repinned.

Each evidence record exposes its role, test revision, exact code, verification, and citation references, and superseded evidence heads; evidence ceases to be current when those pins no longer resolve.
Each recorded run exposes its immutable identity, test revision, result, summary, recorded command, execution time, source repository and commit, parent run heads, and referenced evidence.
A run is not created unless its test revision and named evidence records exist and it names every current run head; otherwise recording fails without adding a run.
